title: gate.ts
swebok: Software Configuration Management · Software Engineering Management
text:
The governance gate: a one-way ratchet with human release.
Agents may PROPOSE tightening. Only humans APPROVE. Loosening/revert is human-only. Nothing is deleted.
Every transition writes the rule and its receipt (ADR-0002: governed durable effects).

title: raindrop.ts
text:
Raindrop AI instrumentation for the RSI loop.
  proposed rule  -> trackAi  (eventId = rule_id; input = the evidence; output = the rule the agent wrote)
  approve/revert -> trackSignal on that eventId (the human's verdict, POSITIVE / NEGATIVE)
  run            -> trackAi  (input = rules active; output = held-out metric)
No-op when RAINDROP_API_KEY is unset; never throws into the loop.
